title: Prepare a reviewable stock-count variance list
reason: A narrow test could compare operator-entered sample counts with sample inventory and produce a variance list for human review. The post supports staff counts and review before stock changes, but no supplied implementation reference supports a live Shopify connection. Provisional mean 5.2 is below threshold.

demandEvidence.chore: No concrete chore is stated in the captured excerpt: You create a count, staff record what is actually on the shelf using barcode scanning or manual entry, and you review the differences before any stock levels change.
